name: Virag Visual Codebook V1

source.title: Try These 100 Codes That Make Your ChatGPT / Gemini Images Look Better (No Design Skills Needed)
source.author: Abhijay Arora Vuyyuru

principles: Treat slash labels as creative shorthand, not literal software commands.
A clear subject/use case matters more than adding many codes.
Prefer one meaningful operator at a time in V1; future combo mode may combine a small compatible set.
If a visual operator conflicts with the current brief, preserve the user's explicit current brief.
